title: ソフトウェアデザイン
subtitle: Software Design
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will achieve the following three objectives:
1) Learn the basic concepts of software design, especially the concept of object-oriented development.
2) Acquire knowledge on a typical software design description language (UML).
3) Learn software design technology through experience from the design to implementation process.
advice:
To develop the software required for an information processing system, it is necessary to analyze the requirements for the system, analyze the system, design the system, conduct system building, software design, software implementation, and system verification, and then perform operational testing.

To understand the importance of software design, it is important to experience it during the system development process.

In this course, students will experience object-oriented development using UML and the Java language. The following main topics will be covered:

1) Object-oriented overview
2) Object-oriented development procedure
3) Analysis, design, and modeling using ULM
4) Program creation using Java

Note: Bring your own laptop computer.

requiredKnowledge:
Check the following three points learned in 'Programming II' (Java basics) and 'Programming III' (Object-oriented programming). Areas not understood sufficiently must be reviewed.
1) Be able to explain basic object-oriented concepts such as class, method, objects, inheritance, etc.
2) Be able to read and explain the Java source code in the examples.
3) Be able to create and run a simple object-oriented Java program.
4) Be able to program in the Python language and operate SQL databases.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the terms of object-oriented programming.
Be able to explain the systems development procedure using UML.
Be able to understand the meaning of graphical symbols in the UML diagrams, and use and draw UML diagrams.
Be able to define classes in the Java programming language.
Be able to explain the terms of a given software testing technique.
Be able to draw the design in UML diagram from program implementation.

In addition to standard achievement goals, it is possible to following three items:

4) Be able to create appropriate UМL diagrams and corresponding Java codes from the requirements.
5) Be able to create UML diagrams from existing Java code and the required specifications.
6) Be able to understand the testing techniques and explain the different techniques used depending on the situation and the state of the project.
achievementLevels.standard:
The following three objectives can be achieved:

1) Be able to explain major terms related to object-oriented software development and Java programming terms.
2) Be able to understand the flow of system development and the UML graphic symbols used.
3) Be able to explain the correspondence between items used in system development and Java class definitions.
